name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.maintenance.InspectionRunService
comment: Staff › Inspections: the run of the day, Room by Room. A failed item creates a Maintenance Request in the item's category (when the schedule asks for it), with the priority its severity sets, and routing rules assign it like any new request. Each Room also has its own checks (spec §6.19): the number of people matches the residents, and every furniture item in it; a failed item's request names the item.

methods.name: current
methods.comment: The oldest run started and not submitted in the Blocks, the user's own first; null when there is none. Runs belong to a Block, not to a Term, so {@code termId} does not filter them.

methods.name: saveRoom
methods.comment: Results of the Room's items; a Room is done once every item is Pass or Fail.

methods.name: saveRoom
methods.comment: Results of the Room's items and, optionally, its meters; a Room is done once every item is answered (and, in a pre-arrival inspection, its meters are read). A Missing item with {@code restock} plans a spare from the Block store; without a spare (or without restock) it becomes a Maintenance Request like a Damaged one.

methods.name: submit
methods.comment: Sends the results to the Block Manager; Rooms not visited stay as they are.

methods.name: submit
methods.comment: Sends the results; {@code confirmed}: the inspector reviewed them and commits to them. The Audit Log keeps the commitment and how many Rooms were left unfinished.

methods.name: runs
methods.comment: Every run of the Blocks the user can open: the runs not sent yet that have started (the user's own first, then the oldest) and the runs sent in the last {@value #SENT_RUNS_DAYS} days, to read and export them.

methods.name: runView
methods.comment: One run of the Blocks, open or sent.

methods.name: addPhoto
methods.comment: A photo of a Room of an open run: of a furniture check ({@code itemId} "furniture-<id>") or, without it, of the meters; at most {@code handover.max_photos} each, JPEG or PNG.

methods.name: removePhoto
methods.comment: Removes a photo of a Room of an open run.

methods.name: upcoming
methods.comment: The next run of each active schedule in the Blocks, soonest first.

methods.name: checks
methods.comment: The Room's own checks: the residents it has now (not in a pre-arrival run: the Room is empty until its new residents arrive, so there is nobody to count), and its furniture items.

methods.name: choice
methods.comment: A Room check's answer. A furniture check may send a condition instead of a result: Good and Worn pass, Damaged and Missing fail; a result alone keeps its meaning (Pass is Good, Fail is Damaged).

methods.name: meters
methods.comment: Checks the meters sent: both readings, not negative, and not lower than the Room's latest reading unless the meter was replaced.

methods.name: preArrival
methods.comment: The run belongs to a pre-arrival schedule: its Rooms need their meters read.

methods.name: currentTermId
methods.comment: A furniture item failed: a Furniture Maintenance Request naming it, whose history the item keeps.

methods.name: roomInfo
methods.comment: Room id → one of its Beds (Room code, floor, Room Type and Class).

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.maintenance.InspectionRunService$Meters
comment: The Room's meters read in the inspection; {@code replaced}: a new meter (the reading may be lower).

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.maintenance.InspectionRunService$Photo
comment: A photo of the inspection: of a furniture check ({@code itemId}) or of the meters (null).

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.maintenance.InspectionRunService$PreviousMeters
comment: The Room's latest recorded meters before this inspection, shown to Staff as a reference note.

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.maintenance.InspectionRunService$RoomCheck
comment: A check of the Room itself, answered like a checklist item ({@link Result#itemId()} = {@code id}).

name: vn.fpt.campusstay.service.maintenance.InspectionRunService$RunsPage
comment: The runs of the Blocks: open ones (the user's first) and the ones sent in the last days.
